title: Peer hook points
description: The JSON form of this extension's hook points: <point>_input carries the kernel hook environment, <point>_output is what a hook answers.

peer_auth_required_input.description: A peer rejected the credentials or asked for authorization.

status.description: HTTP status of a rejected request; absent when the task itself entered auth-required.

data.description: Extra detail from the peer, as it sent it.

peer_auth_required_output.description: Retry means the host fixed the credentials out of band.

metadata.description: Sent first, in a message without parts, to a task waiting for credentials.
